{{Top|leg}}
A '''matter analyzer''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. The [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] used matter analyzers to monitor conditions in passenger staterooms and public areas.
